description:
“My body was stolen—and by my husband’s mistress, of all people!” 

Kanami is a housewife living in a luxury high-rise apartment in Minato, Tokyo, where elegance and comfort have become part of her everyday life. But one day, she suddenly wakes up in the body of a complete stranger. Amid the confusion, Kanami soon discovers the horrifying truth: the body she is now inhabiting belongs to the woman her husband has been having an affair with. Still reeling from the revelation, Kanami returns home—only to suffer an even greater shock when she sees another woman, inside Kanami’s own body, casually living alongside her husband as though nothing has happened. Someone has taken over her body. At this rate, she will lose not only her husband, but her entire life. She has to find a way to return to her original body. Then, a mysterious figure appears before her. 

“Your husband has at least three other women.” 

Besides Kanami and the mistress whose body she now inhabits, there are still others lurking in the shadows—women whose identities have yet to be revealed.
